goals.title: Project website and documentation
goals.detail: Overview, package guides, verified progress and a roadmap in one place.

goals.title: Reusable Effect runtime
goals.detail: Lazy effects, typed failures, resources, services, concurrency and streams.

goals.title: PostgreSQL and MySQL integrations
goals.detail: Established Dart drivers, scoped connections, transactions and real database acceptance.

goals.title: OpenAI SDK integration
goals.detail: Typed requests, Responses and Chat streams, scoped clients and local HTTP/SSE acceptance.

goals.title: Live OpenAI Responses smoke acceptance
goals.detail: Two native live Responses streams passed with text, Unicode, terminal completion and awaited cleanup through user-authorized ChatGPT plan access.

goals.title: First pub.dev release
goals.detail: All five packages are published on pub.dev. PostgreSQL 0.0.2 includes documented public APIs and a verified 160/160 score.

goals.title: Production database acceptance
goals.detail: Trusted root/intermediate CA chains and hostname rejection passed for both drivers. Connection loss, network interruption, load/soak and version coverage remain open.
goals.dependency: A reproducible database version matrix and isolated TLS/failover test environments.
goals.acceptance: Record PostgreSQL and MySQL CA verification, interrupted transactions, failover, network partitions and soak results, including cleanup and rollback outcomes.

tasks.title: Trusted CA chains and hostname verification

goals.title: Broader OpenAI live acceptance
goals.detail: Other API endpoints, live browser transport, load/soak and failure injection remain unverified. ChatGPT plan access covers only eligible Responses requests.
goals.dependency: An API-enabled test account and a server-side credential are required; ChatGPT subscription access is not general API coverage.
goals.acceptance: Record successful and failed live requests for supported endpoints, browser transport through a safe test backend, cancellation and bounded load/soak; retain endpoint-specific evidence.

goals.title: Runnable API and Flutter integration guides
goals.detail: Show application-owned runtimes, shared service layers, safe read retry, SQL transactions and server-side OpenAI access.
goals.dependency: Existing released packages; a Flutter device target for native acceptance.
goals.acceptance: Run the API example and Flutter lifecycle journey, including owner shutdown and interruption; publish commands and platform-specific results.

goals.title: Typed configuration, schemas and cache lifetimes
goals.detail: Explore structured schema issues, encode/decode round trips, configuration loading and scoped cache expiry.
goals.dependency: Agree on a small Dart-native API and lifecycle contracts before implementation.
goals.acceptance: Independent issue/round-trip tests, deterministic expiry tests and documented error/resource behavior.

goals.title: Broader streams and coordination primitives
goals.detail: Consider queue strategies, graceful end, replay PubSub, stream merging/grouping/time operators and Sink leftovers.
goals.dependency: Prioritize operators from actual application needs and define backpressure and cancellation contracts.
goals.acceptance: Independent bounded-buffer, early-exit, interruption and exactly-once cleanup scenarios for each advertised operator.

goals.title: Optional metrics and tracing adapters
goals.detail: Expose useful service and fiber observations without adding runtime dependencies to core.
goals.dependency: Select Dart observability interfaces and decide privacy, overhead and exporter boundaries.
goals.acceptance: Verify successful/failed/interrupted spans, scoped exporter cleanup and measured overhead.

goals.title: Flutter and isolate integration helpers
goals.detail: Explore Flutter owner lifetimes and explicit isolate sendability helpers outside the portable core.
goals.dependency: Define ownership and supported platform contracts; choose real device acceptance targets.
goals.acceptance: Run native Flutter disposal journeys and isolate sendability/error propagation tests; record unsupported platforms.
